i.norm: Tests that {@link EnumUtils#generateBitVector(Class, Iterable)} rejects enums that cannot be represented in a single {@code long}.

{@code TooMany} declares more than {@link Long#SIZE} (64) constants, so its members cannot be packed into the 64 bits of a single {@code long}. {@code generateBitVector} must therefore reject it with an {@link IllegalArgumentException}, even when only a single value is supplied.
